saw_lines: Non-alcoholic drinkers ask whether it tastes like a real aperitif, then reorder only when it does.
So the sale turns on line one, where the offer and the answer to taste must land before the shopper scrolls.
Your site offers 10% off your first order, yet 3 of 27 ads mention it, so buyers have no reason to act. Put the offer in line one of three new ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 12 Oct 2026
points: Your site gives new buyers 10% off their first order, yet 3 of 27 ads mention it, so a first time buyer has no reason to click. Open three new ads with the offer in line one and on the creative.

Your site offers Subscribe and save, 15% off every order that follows, yet 0 of 30 ads mention a subscription. Buyers get no prompt to reorder, so repeats depend on memory. Run two retention ads with the saving as the headline.

Your site explains how it ships, yet 0 of 30 ads show how an order arrives. Buyers unsure about delivery scroll past without asking. Shoot one video ad of the box arriving, with the delivery promise in line one.

0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so a first buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure you can stand behind, like a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
